TIME_STOP.title: Time Stop
TIME_STOP.description:
While in [gold]Time Stop[/gold], all damage is delayed until [gold]Time Stop[/gold] ends.
Playing cards no longer costs energy, but instead costs [blue]6[/blue] times the [purple]TSP[/purple].
TSP.title: TSP
TSP.description:
Alternative energy used during [gold]Time Stop[/gold]; when exhausted, immediately exit [gold]Time Stop[/gold] and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
At the start of a turn when not in [gold]Time Stop[/gold], naturally recover [blue]12.5%[/blue] of [purple]TSP[/purple].
The first time you enter [gold]Time Stop[/gold] each combat, gain [purple]TSP[/purple] equal to the intent value of all enemies intending to attack at that moment.
KNIFE.title: Knife
KNIFE.description: Each knife deals [blue]1[/blue] damage when thrown (affected by [gold]Strength[/gold]).
